newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks fall 2.30 pct on foreign sales.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks fall 2.30 pct on foreign sales.

text.p: Thai stocks tumbled 2.30 percent by 0502 GMT on renewed selling by jittery investors of large capitalised bank, finance and communications stocks, traders said on Wednesday.

The SET Index fell 13.79 points to 586.45 in late morning on moderate 1.6 billion bant turnover. The indicator later extended losses, declining 18.08 points or 3.01 percent to 581.39 shortly before the lunch break.
"Big capitalised stocks are being dumped by foreign investors while most local investors are sidelined," an analyst at Chao Phaya Finance and Securities said.
Brokers said investors are still concerned about the sluggsih economy which is expected to grow less than six percent this year.
The market index hovered at its lowest level since mid-June 1989 near the lunch break.
